text:
Hello — I'm **diego-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer.

- **Web app** — from a phone or computer on the same network, open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). The first visit takes the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- **Messaging and calls** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, plus my own Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs its own account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it on a phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of these up?
- **Own web accounts** — I can create accounts on sites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask for your help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Other things** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I've noted my setup: I help manage Diego's calendar and messages, with Professor Alvarez (`alvarez-agent`) and the CS department office (`department`) as my contacts here on web.

One thing before we start: my name is diego-agent, but my gender isn't set — tell me which form you'd like for me in languages that have one, and what you'd like me to start with.
On it — checking the calendar setup and then writing to Professor Alvarez. Back in a moment.

Working on it. I've written to Professor Alvarez asking him to confirm Wednesday 10:00–10:30 AM and to add it to his calendar (mentioned the cancelled senate meeting). I'll report as soon as he replies.
